finding.headline: "The TikTok Realisation (Diaspora)"
finding.problem: "I found out from TikTok I have this. Every program is white faces, £100, and talks about 'self-care' like I have time. I just want something my mum would understand."
finding.person: Ada, 31, UK-Nigerian, 4 months PP, self-diagnosed DR from an Instagram reel, drowning in £99+ Western apps she can't justify.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Marketing angle / entry point (culturally-native alternative to Western apps)". Verdict: PASSES.
